title: DSA: Evidence-Aware LLM-Agent Orchestration for Multi-Market Stock Research
abstract: arXiv:2608.26990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can summarize financial information, but an operational stock-research system must first assemble heterogeneous evidence, expose unavailable data and model capabilities, and control how generated opinions affect a final report. We present DSA, an evidence-aware orchestration framework for multi-market stock research with large language model (LLM) agents. DSA organizes the workflow into evidence acquisition, structured context construction, model-routed analysis, optional role and Strategy Skill reasoning, and report generation with selected context and diagnostics. A default report profile and an optional agentic profile share evidence and model-routing services but use profile-specific output validation and risk safeguards. In the agentic profile, core role outputs are processed by role-specific parsers, whereas Strategy Skill opinions undergo an additional signal-eligibility partition before synthesis; disagreeme

translated_title: DSA：面向多市场股票研究的证据感知型LLM代理编排框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26990v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型可以总结金融信息，但一个可操作的股票研究系统必须首先整合异构证据，暴露不可用数据和模型能力，并控制生成的见解如何影响最终报告。我们提出了DSA，一个用于多市场股票研究的证据感知型编排框架，基于大型语言模型（LLM）代理。DSA将工作流组织为证据获取、结构化上下文构建、模型路由分析、可选角色和策略技能推理，以及使用选定上下文和诊断的报告生成。一个默认报告配置和一个可选的代理配置共享证据和模型路由服务，但使用特定于配置的输出验证和风险保障。在代理配置中，核心角色输出由角色特定的解析器处理，而策略技能见解在综合前经过额外的信号资格划分；分歧处理被显式管理。
tldr: DSA提出了一种证据感知的LLM代理编排框架，通过整合异构证据、模型路由和角色/策略推理，实现了多市场股票研究的可控报告生成。
en_tdlr: DSA proposes an evidence-aware LLM-agent orchestration framework that enables controllable report generation for multi-market stock research by integrating heterogeneous evidence, model routing, and role/strategy reasoning.
